welcome.title: Hibiscus Station
welcome.lead: Station runs next to your robot. Data stays on this machine until you upload it.
welcome.robot_desc: Pick the USB ports, calibrate both arms, add cameras.
welcome.pair_desc: Upload datasets, train on the server, pull the trained model back. You can do this later in Settings.

pair.token_hint: Create a token on the server: Account → Tokens.
pair.create_token: Create a token with the right scopes

robot.title: Robot
robot.desc: Robot profiles: ports, calibration ids and safety defaults.
robot.empty: No robot yet. Create one to start.
robot.name: Name

robot.unplug_now: Unplug the arm's USB cable now…

calibrate.title: Calibrate
calibrate.desc: Calibrate each arm once. The file is stored in lerobot's calibration folder.

calibrate.limp: The follower is limp: hold it.
calibrate.arm_alt: SO-101 arm with every joint in the middle of its range
calibrate.home_text: Move every joint to the middle of its range, then press Set home.
calibrate.ranges_text: Move each joint slowly through its whole range. Rows turn green once the range is big enough.

cameras.title: Cameras

teleop.title: Teleop
teleop.desc: Move the leader arm; the follower copies it. Nothing is recorded.

teleop.approach: Follower moving to the leader pose…

replay.title: Replay
replay.desc: A recorded episode drives the follower.

record.desc: Record a LeRobot dataset with the leader arm.

record.estimate: About {{mb}} MB per episode with {{cams}} camera(s), {{total}} GiB in total.
